verdict.rationale: RingCentral's Business SMS Booster is described as offering a shared inbox, templates, and "compliance tools" for customer texting. That is a first-party SMS compliance capability, but the evidence never says what those tools do. Nothing specifically confirms automatic STOP/HELP keyword handling or suppression of opted-out contacts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic STOP/HELP keyword processing, opt-out list suppression on future sends, API/admin details of opt-out management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
